text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Say, Yaeno and Bamboo. Do you like
spicy
foods?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I can handle the heat, yeah. Why do you
ask?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Well the thing is, I accidentally bought a
bunch of
really spicy curry. I can really
only go for the
sweeter varieties, so...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see where this is going. Bamboo?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not great at handling spicy stuff, but
I do like
it. I'm up for the challenge!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Can't handle it, but like it all the same?
What's
that all about?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I just get real fired up on the inside
when I eat
spicy stuff! Makes me feel
alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see! It's like how carrots taste better
after a bout
of hard work!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Feeling alive? And why bring up
carrots? I'm not
sure what these two are
on about...)
